title: MMGenBench: An Automated Pipeline for Evaluating LMMs from a Text-to-Image Generation Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2411.14062v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing benchmarks often rely on predefined questions or reference captions, limiting their flexibility for evaluating detailed descriptions on new image collections. We present MMGenBench, an automated benchmark framework for evaluating Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) from raw images without per-image questions or reference captions. The pipeline generates descriptions, reconstructs images with a frozen text-to-image model, and compares the original and reconstructed images using a frozen image encoder. It produces reusable per-image scores and inspectable reconstructions, supporting both model comparison and diagnosis of reconstructible visual information. We construct MMGenBench-Domain with 10,000 generated images and MMGenBench-Test with 1,284 images spanning 13 overlapping visual patterns. translated_title: MMGenBench：一种从文本到图像生成视角评估大型多模态模型的自动化流水线
translated_abstract: 现有基准测试通常依赖预定义的问题或参考描述，这限制了它们在新图像集上评估详细描述的灵活性。我们提出了MMGenBench，这是一个自动化基准测试框架，可直接从原始图像评估大型多模态模型（LMMs），无需逐图像的问题或参考描述。该流水线先生成图像描述，再使用冻结的文本到图像模型重建图像，并通过冻结的图像编码器比较原始图像与重建图像。它能够产出可复用的逐图像评分和可检查的重建结果，既支持模型比较，也支持对可重建视觉信息的诊断。我们构建了包含10,000张生成图像的MMGenBench-Domain，以及包含1,284张图像、覆盖13种重叠视觉模式的MMGenBench-Test。对68个LMM的评估揭示了重建质量上存在总体分数可能掩盖的模式特定差异。在1,000张人工标注的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: MMGenBench是一个无需预定义问题或参考描述的自动化基准框架，通过“图像描述生成→文生图重建→编码器比对”的流水线从原始图像评估大型多模态模型，对68个LMM的评估揭示了总分可能掩盖的模式特定重建质量差异。
en_tdlr: MMGenBench is an automated benchmark that evaluates LMMs directly from raw images—without predefined questions or reference captions—via a pipeline of caption generation, text-to-image reconstruction, and encoder-based comparison, revealing pattern-specific differences in reconstruction quality across 68 models that overall scores can obscure.
